name: @bandicoot/bivot
description: Viewer for Bandicoot Shimmer View images
author: dkarlov

scripts.build: microbundle       --no-sourcemap --no-compress --css-modules false --no-pkg-main -o dist/index.js -f esm --jsx React.createElement --jsxFragment React.Fragment
scripts.watch: microbundle watch --no-sourcemap --no-compress --css-modules false --no-pkg-main -o dist/index.js -f esm --jsx React.createElement --jsxFragment React.Fragment
scripts.debug:example: run-s build && cp dist/index.js example/node_modules/@bandicoot/bivot/dist && cp package.json example/node_modules/@bandicoot/bivot && node scripts/sync-runtime-deps.cjs example && rm -rf example/.next/cache
scripts.debug:shopfront: run-s build && cp dist/index.js ../shopfront/node_modules/@bandicoot/bivot/dist && cp package.json ../shopfront/node_modules/@bandicoot/bivot && node scripts/sync-runtime-deps.cjs ../shopfront && rm -rf ../shopfront/.next/cache
scripts.predeploy: cd example && pnpm install && pnpm run build
